title: luzula intermedia var. multiflora
intro: Luzula intermedia var. multiflora, commonly known as many-flowered woodrush, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Juncaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with various conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
